objective: Produce the smallest tested teacher-free LayerCake English substrate that generalizes across natural prompt forms, matches or exceeds its frozen source on the locked source-passing suite, and preserves the LayerCake execution gates.

acquisition_paths.description: Diverse cached teacher text with authoritative output token accounting.
Frozen-source activations projected into the LayerCake ABI with every activation byte and bridge parameter accounted.
Architecture-compatible embedding, vocabulary, or factor information plus behavioral conformance; copied source machinery must be identified and absent from the final runtime.
A fair student receiving the same prompts and imported-information budget.

forbidden_shortcuts: template-specific symbolic response handlers used to pass promotion prompts
selection on validation or final-test prompts
quality from one lineage combined with speed from another
teacher, source output cache, logits, hidden activations, or source blocks at inference
claiming a global minimum from a finite budget frontier
claiming exhaustive domain discovery or universal semantic identity
decision_rule: Promote the lowest passing tested nested imported-information budget only after every quality and execution gate passes on the same exact final candidate. Otherwise preserve the failure and keep the product moonshot open.
claim_boundary: This contract defines a falsifiable successor campaign. It does not assert that arbitrary source models admit lossless compression into a smaller non-isomorphic LayerCake.
